section.content: 本实用新型公开了基因检测技术领域的一种生物基因用基因检测探针，包括壳体、固定块、电池箱、保护壳和安装箱，所述固定块固定连接在所述壳体的顶部，所述电池箱镶嵌在所述壳体的外侧壁左上侧，所述保护壳套接在所述壳体的外侧壁下侧，所述安装箱插接在所述壳体的底部中间，所述壳体的外侧壁下侧固定连接有卡接环，所述固定块的内腔底部中间固定连接有信息处理装置，该生物基因用基因检测探针，结构设计合理，有效的避免了因重复使用而导致检测结果产生差异，保证了设备检测时数据的有效性，提高了产品使用时的质量，实现了对针头的有效保护，提高设备的防护性，进一步提高了设备使用时的产品质量。

The utility model discloses a gene detection probe for biological genes in the technical field of gene detection, which comprises a shell, a fixed block, a battery box, a protective shell and an installation box, wherein the fixed block is fixedly connected to the top of the shell, the battery box is embedded on the left upper side of the outer side wall of the shell, the protective shell is sleeved on the lower side of the outer side wall of the shell, the installation box is inserted in the middle of the bottom of the shell, a clamping ring is fixedly connected to the lower side of the outer side wall of the shell, and an information processing device is fixedly connected to the middle of the bottom of an inner cavity of the fixed block, so that the gene detection probe for biological genes has reasonable structural design, effectively avoids the generation of difference of detection results caused by repeated use, ensures the validity of data during detection of equipment, improves the quality of products during use, realizes the effective protection of needle heads, and improves the protection of the equipment, further improving the product quality when the equipment is used.

Gene detection probe for biological geneTechnical Field

The utility model relates to the technical field of gene detection, in particular to a gene detection probe for biological genes.

Background

Gene probes, i.e.nucleic acid probes, are nucleic acid sequences complementary to the gene of interest, with a detectable label and known sequence, and in order to determine whether the probe hybridizes to the corresponding genomic DNA, it is necessary to label the probe in order to obtain a recognizable signal at the binding site, usually a certain alpha phosphate group of the probe is labeled with the radioisotope 32P, but recently some systems have been developed in which small single-stranded oligonucleotide probes can be synthesized ex vivo by machines using non-isotopes such as biotin, which are stable and highly specific, and which can detect single base mutations and single base mismatches under very stringent conditions, but which are short, carry few labels, and are less sensitive.

Gene probe is using the required measuring sample of direct contact, need reuse in order to save cost syringe needle, but used repeatedly's syringe needle leads to the testing result to produce the difference, influence the validity of testing data, lead to the practicality of equipment to reduce, be unfavorable for guaranteeing the quality when product uses, current gene probe all adopts empty sample jar to cup joint to protect simultaneously, lead to gene probe's protectiveness low, be unfavorable for the protection to gene probe, we have proposed a gene testing probe for biological gene for this reason.

SUMMERY OF THE UTILITY MODEL

The utility model aims to provide a gene detection probe for biological genes, which aims to solve the problems that the detection result is different due to the fact that needles are repeatedly used, the validity of detection data is influenced, the practicability of equipment is reduced, the quality of products in use is not guaranteed, the protection performance of the gene probe is low, and the protection of the gene probe is not facilitated.

In order to achieve the purpose, the utility model provides the following technical scheme: the utility model provides a gene detection probe for biological gene, includes casing, fixed block, battery box, protective housing and install bin, the fixed block fixed connection be in the top of casing, the battery box is inlayed the lateral wall upper left side of casing, the protective housing cup joints the lateral wall downside of casing, the install bin is pegged graft in the middle of the bottom of casing, the lateral wall downside fixedly connected with joint ring of casing, fixedly connected with information processing apparatus in the middle of the inner chamber bottom of fixed block, open at the inside wall top of install bin has the thread groove.

Preferably, the upper right side of the inner side wall of the shell is fixedly connected with a control box, and the control box is electrically connected with the battery box.

Preferably, the middle of the top of the inner cavity of the fixing block is fixedly connected with a wireless signal device, and the wireless signal device is electrically connected with the control box.

Preferably, the left side wall of battery box articulates there is the apron, the left side wall front side of apron is opened flutedly.

Preferably, a clamping groove is formed in the middle of the inner side wall of the protective shell and sleeved on the outer side wall of the clamping ring, and the outer side wall of the protective shell is fixedly connected with an anti-falling layer.

Preferably, the inner cavity of the thread groove is in threaded connection with an information acquisition device, the information acquisition device is electrically connected with the control box, and the bottom of the information acquisition device is fixedly connected with a needle.

Compared with the prior art, the utility model has the beneficial effects that:

1. this gene detection probe for biological gene adopts the installation form of install bin in equipment, connects syringe needle and information acquisition device through the screw thread mode and installs, can directly take off the syringe needle when used repeatedly and disinfect, and the effectual detection result that has avoided leading to because of used repeatedly produces the difference, has guaranteed the validity of equipment detection time measuring data, has improved the quality when the product uses.

2. This gene detection probe for biological gene has increased the joint ring at the lateral wall of casing, cup joints the protective housing in the downside of casing lateral wall, prevents falling the layer at the lateral wall fixedly connected with of protective housing simultaneously, has realized the effective protection to the syringe needle, and improve equipment's protectiveness has further improved the product quality when the equipment uses.

In the figure: 100. a housing; 110. a control box; 120. a snap ring; 200. a fixed block; 210. a wireless signal device; 220. an information processing device; 300. a battery box; 310. a cover plate; 320. a groove; 400. a protective shell; 410. a clamping groove; 420. an anti-falling layer; 500. installing a box; 510. a thread groove; 520. an information acquisition device; 530. a needle.

Detailed Description

The utility model provides a gene detection probe for biological genes, which effectively avoids the difference of detection results caused by repeated use, ensures the validity of data in equipment detection, improves the quality of products in use, realizes the effective protection of needles, improves the protection of equipment, and further improves the product quality of equipment in use, and please refer to fig. 1-3, and the gene detection probe comprises a shell 100, a fixed block 200, a battery box 300, a protective shell 400 and a mounting box 500;

referring to fig. 1 to 3 again, the lower side of the outer side wall of the casing 100 is fixedly connected with a clamping ring 120, the casing 100 is used for connecting and installing the fixing block 200, the battery box 300, the protective casing 400 and the installation box 500, and the clamping ring 120 is connected with the casing 100 and the protective casing 400;

referring to fig. 1-3 again, the middle of the bottom of the inner cavity of the fixing block 200 is fixedly connected with an information processing device 220, the fixing block 200 is fixedly connected to the top of the housing 100, the fixing block 200 is used for connecting and installing the wireless signal device 210, and the information processing device 220 is used for electrically connecting the control box 110;

referring to fig. 1-3 again, the battery box 300 is embedded on the left upper side of the outer side wall of the housing 100, and the battery box 300 is used for connecting the mounting cover plate 310;

referring to fig. 1-3 again, a protective shell 400 is sleeved on the lower side of the outer sidewall of the casing 100, and the protective shell 400 is used for connecting and installing the anti-falling layer 420;

referring to fig. 1-3 again, the top of the inner sidewall of the mounting box 500 is provided with a screw groove 510, the mounting box 500 is inserted into the middle of the bottom of the casing 100, the mounting box 500 is provided with a screw groove 510, and the screw groove 510 is used for connecting and mounting the information processing device 220.

Referring to fig. 1-3 again, in order to facilitate control of the internal devices of the apparatus, the control box 110 is fixedly connected to the upper right side of the inner sidewall of the casing 100, and the control box 110 is electrically connected to the battery box 300.

Referring to fig. 1 to 3 again, in order to transmit the detection data to the device terminal, a wireless signal device 210 is fixedly connected to the middle of the top of the inner cavity of the fixing block 200, and the wireless signal device 210 is electrically connected to the control box 110.

Referring to fig. 1-3 again, in order to replace the battery when in use, the left side wall of the battery box 300 is hinged with a cover plate 310, and the front side of the left side wall of the cover plate 310 is provided with a groove 320.

Referring to fig. 1-3 again, in order to protect the detection probe, a clamping groove 410 is formed in the middle of the inner sidewall of the protection shell 400, the clamping groove 410 is sleeved on the outer sidewall of the clamping ring 120, and an anti-falling layer 420 is fixedly connected to the outer sidewall of the protection shell 400.

Referring to fig. 1-3 again, in order to facilitate the detachment and installation of the needle 530, the inner cavity of the screw groove 510 is threadedly connected with an information acquisition device 520, the information acquisition device 520 is electrically connected with the control box 110, and the bottom of the information acquisition device 520 is fixedly connected with the needle 530.

In a specific use, a person skilled in the art pulls out the external stable protection case 400 of the device, exposes the needle 530 of the device, the cover plate 310 is opened through the groove 320, the battery card is inserted into the middle of the inner cavity of the battery case 300, the cover plate 310 is closed in the groove 320, and the gene sample to be detected is directly contacted with the needle 530 to trigger the power switch of the device, the information is transmitted through the control box 110, then transmitted to the information processing device 220 through the information acquisition device 520, finally transmitted to the equipment terminal through the wireless signal device 210 for analysis, the power supply is automatically turned off after the detection is finished, when the needle 530 is cleaned or replaced, the needle is directly taken out in a counterclockwise rotation manner, after the cleaned needle 530 or the new needle 530 is inserted into the cavity of the screw groove 510 of the mounting box 500 by clockwise rotation, the protective case 400 is sleeved on the lower side of the outer side wall of the housing 100 after the use is finished.
